_doc: Fixtures + thresholds for .harmony/probe-video.sh (s-rta-0928b video: video decodes off the GL thread; .harmony/.reports/s-rta-0928b/plan-video.md section 4.6 + HARMONY ADOPTION V2/V4/V5). Rows and calibration: the docstring of .harmony/probe-video.py. Fixtures: 10 s, 30 fps, 300 frames, encoded with ffmpeg (nice'd, -threads 2) into <out>/media before the app starts, or reused from $VIDEO_FIXTURES when it holds them (the keyframe list is re-asserted with ffprobe on every run). Every fixture carries a frame-number code band: the bottom bandRows rows, 10 cells, cell c white iff bit c of the code (drawbox per bit; decoded by thresholding each cell's inner 50 % at 128). @OUT@ = the fixture path.
_fpsMin: median /api/state fps over the 5 s steady window (w1, w8); the diag's v1 arm (no decode, uploads kept) gave 95.9-117 fps. w1 (a) PASS = >= fpsMin in >= w1PassMin of w1Repeats runs (ADDENDUM W2)
_fpsPollS: ADDENDUM W2: the fps rows (w1, w2, w8) poll /api/state every 50 ms -- a 15 ms poller perturbs the fps it measures (lane 120 fps at 50 ms polls vs 86-120 under 15 ms; main ~89 either way)
_fps4k: ADDENDUM W1 (ruled with evidence, not a silent re-threshold): w2 (a) fps >= fps4kMin (main 36; the upload-bound ceiling on this M1 Pro: 4 x 4K video 84-90 fps with 0 GL-thread decodes) AND (a2) fps >= the same launch's 4 x 4K STILL scene fps - fps4kBelowStillsMax (stills measured 108-110). '4 x 4K video at the display rate' is filed (zero-copy upload: IOSurface / VideoToolbox)
_w9FadeS: w9's layer transitionSpeed 2.0 = a 2 s fade (w6b: done at 2.02-2.03 s); PASS = done within w9FadeS + 0.5 s (ADDENDUM W3)
_broken: w9 (ADDENDUM W3): a 2 s 1080p encode (+faststart) cut to its header (ftyp + moov + the mdat header + 8 bytes) or with its mdat payload zeroed. HAP: the pixel format is known without a frame (Hap1 -> rgb0), so open() succeeds and the first frame never decodes (EOF / a decode error before any frame). players = the players load_composition makes. NOT an arm: an H.264 .mp4 cut to its header -- no pixel format without a frame (ffprobe pix_fmt=unknown), and VideoPlayer::open() passes AV_PIX_FMT_NONE to sws_getContext, which ABORTS the app ('Assertion desc failed at libswscale/swscale_internal.h:758', SIGABRT in Renderer::openVideoForClip on the message thread; seen on the 90cdf55 app, fix round 1) -- a crash, filed for a ruling; never run it against a build without a pix_fmt guard (the crash raises the system 'quit unexpectedly' dialog)
_uploads5s: 4 players x 30 content frames/s x 5 s = 600 uploads when a frame is uploaded once; every-render-frame upload = ~2400
_b1080: b1080 is the NEGATED testsrc2 picture (plus code bit 9): a crossfade mid-point is then a blend distinguishable from both A and B (w6 (c)); the band is drawn after the negate, so it decodes like A's
